d:
While Gokuldham Society is undergoing renovation, the men sleep together in a tent while the women stay upstairs. Daya tells a spooky ghost story that scares everyone until they realize the eerie noises are just the construction workers singing to blow off steam. The society members join in and sing along with them.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
